description: Flow, not snapshot: the largest transfers of a Base token in the last 24h, classified by whether whales are sending INTO DEX pools (sell pressure) or pulling OUT (accumulation) — a net sell-pressure read that decays in hours. Complements holder-forensics ('who could dump') with 'is anyone dumping now'. CDP-indexed events.
name: whale_flow

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.
